result.summary: Identified a few visual and content inconsistencies across promotional tags and horizontal scroll sections.

issues.description: Discount badge displays '-0%', providing no actual discount value to the user.
issues.suggestion: Hide the badge when the discount is zero or verify discount calculation logic.

issues.description: Category chips and horizontal cards clip abruptly at the right screen edge without clear scroll affordance.
issues.suggestion: Add edge gradient fading or consistent margin to signal horizontal scrollability.
